# Clinical Quality

This folder covers the evaluation of clinical quality in postoperative care, focusing on specific national metrics used to assess patient safety. It details benchmarks such as Indikator 5, which tracks the proportion of high-risk surgical patients in Denmark—defined as those with an ASA score ≥ 3 or aged 75 and older—who receive extended monitoring in intermediate units. The data highlights that only 22.9% of these vulnerable patients receive the recommended 24-hour postoperative observation, providing a concrete measure of current clinical quality and safety protocols across the country.

## Pages

- [[clinical-quality|Clinical Quality]] — Details national postoperative care metrics, specifically tracking the extended monitoring rates of high-risk surgical patients in Denmark.
